think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and allowed range from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether the knob defines one or more sentinel numeric values (e.g., 0, -1) that switch the behavior to a qualitatively different mode (such as disabling a feature or using an automatic/default path), rather than merely scaling the same effect. 3) If such sentinel values exist, classify it as a special knob and record those special values; otherwise classify it as not special.
